description: Look up USGS parameter codes — the 5-digit codes every other tool's parameterCd takes. With no query, lists a curated set of well-known codes with names, units, and thematic group, from a built-in table (no network call): 00060 = "Discharge" (ft³/s), 00065 = "Gage height" (ft), 00010 = "Temperature, water" (°C), 72019 = "Depth to water level" (ft), and others; filter it with group. For anything else — turbidity, nitrate, chlorophyll, suspended sediment, salinity — pass query to search the full USGS parameter-code catalog (~19,700 codes) by name and description, or pass a 5-digit code to look it up. Matches list curated codes first. limit (default 25, 1–4,000) and offset (default 0) window whichever list the call selects; total counts every match, and nextOffset names the next page while entries remain.

group.description: Filter the curated list by thematic domain: "streamflow", "groundwater", "temperature", "meteorological", "water-quality", or "all" (default). Applies to the curated list only — leave it "all" when passing query.

limit.description: Most entries to return, 1–4,000. Default 25. Applies to the query matches, or to the curated list when query is omitted; offset (default 0) picks where the window starts.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip before the window starts. Default 0. Pass the previous response's nextOffset, with the same query and limit (default 25, up to 4,000), for the next page.

query.description: Search the full USGS parameter-code catalog. Case-insensitive; every word must start a word in the parameter name or description (e.g. "turbidity", "nitrate filtered", "dissolved oxygen"). A bare 5-digit code (e.g. "63680") returns that code. Omit to list the curated codes.

name: water_list_parameters

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `query_with_group`: query was combined with a group other than "all". group filters the curated list only; the USGS catalog carries no matching grouping. `upstream_error`: The USGS parameter-code catalog could not be read — the request failed, timed out, or returned something other than a catalog page. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page, present while entries remain after this window (truncated is true) — pass it as offset with the same query and limit to continue. Absent on the last page. The window is set by limit (default 25, 1–4,000) and offset (default 0).

note.description: Guidance when a query matched nothing, the window holds part of the matches (which entries, and the next offset while any remain), or offset is past the end (the valid range). Absent when the window holds every match.

parameters.description: The window of matching entries, in a fixed order: without query, the curated codes; with query, matching curated codes first (each once, as its curated entry), then catalog records whose name holds every query word, then those matched through the description, each by code. The window is set by limit (default 25, 1–4,000) and offset (default 0).

description.description: USGS catalog description, naming the medium, fraction, and method (e.g. "Turbidity, water, unfiltered, … formazin nephelometric units (FNU)"). Present on usgs-catalog entries only.

group.description: Thematic domain of a curated entry. Absent on usgs-catalog entries.

source.description: "curated": one of the well-known codes this server lists by default. "usgs-catalog": a record from the full USGS parameter-code catalog.

query.description: The catalog query searched, trimmed. Absent when listing the curated codes.

total.description: Number of entries that matched — every match, before limit/offset windowing.

truncated.description: True when entries remain after this window, which nextOffset then continues from; false on the last page and for an offset past the end. The window is set by limit (default 25, 1–4,000) and offset (default 0).

title: Water List Parameters
